name: LionDallas
description: Compact DS18B20 driver over OneWire for the Lion* stack: discover sensor addresses once and keep them, non-blocking reads inside a LionCriticalTask, last-good caching with a fault-tolerance window, and the DallasTemperature 4.0.6 power-on-reset / insufficient-power / fault detection. Optional fixed addresses skip the unreliable SearchROM on long buses. DS18B20 family (0x28) only. ESP8266 only (uses LionTask's LionCriticalTask and LionLogger).
keywords: ds18b20, onewire, temperature, dallas, sensor, esp8266, embedded, arduino
